name: Bastion Lunchbox Fixes
derivation: Known-working v1.0.4 / exact-v13 Bastion runtime plus the unchanged Codex Module Bridge v1 compatibility dispatcher; v1.0.5 changes packaging/configuration generation only
preserved_v13_behavior: 14 exact zone hashes and expected HP checks
v1.0.5_changes: Reduced Arsenal choices from eight to three
Changed disabled option literals from variable-width false to fixed-width nil-space so generated Lua size does not change
Padded runtime configuration labels to a fixed 25-byte width
Added build assertions requiring identical Lua size, archive size, and resource data offset for all variants
Kept the v1.0.4 Codex Module Bridge v1 compatibility dispatcher unchanged and optional

codex_module_bridge_v1_compatibility.purpose: Allow Codex Module Bridge v1 and Bastion Lunchbox Fix to remain independently installable despite both defining mods/codex/gun_calibration
codex_module_bridge_v1_compatibility.required_load_order_when_present: Bastion Lunchbox Fix must have winning priority for mods/codex/gun_calibration
codex_module_bridge_v1_compatibility.behavior: Uses stingray.Application.can_get before require, isolates lookup/load failures, and uses the CodexModuleBridge global guard to prevent duplicate initialization
codex_module_bridge_v1_compatibility.scope: Compatibility is specifically for Codex Module Bridge v1 behavior observed in the supplied package; future bridge versions require revalidation

variants.name: Light Lunch Boxes + Side Skirts 0% Main

compatibility_warning: Still uses mods/codex/gun_calibration. Codex Module Bridge v1 is supported only when Bastion wins that resource. HUD Ballistic Trajectory Overlay v2 remains incompatible with this implementation.
static_datalibrary_note: A decoded generated_entities.dl_bin contains the proven Bastion structure at 0x994006, but the retail loose DataLibrary is encrypted. Deploying the decoded bytes directly is not a valid replacement, so v1.0.5 retains the proven runtime writer.
superseded_builds: v1.0.0-v1.0.2 used a reconstructed layout/locator. v1.0.3 introduced the exact-v13 core. v1.0.4 added Codex Bridge v1 compatibility. v1.0.5 is the option/packaging stability cleanup.
